RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the December 14, 2005/Agrahayana 23, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs;
Non-Conventional Energy Sources; Power; Rural
Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
Import of pepper
*301. SHRI N.K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government allowed pepper
import from other countries and if so, how
many nations have been allowed free trade
of pepper with our country;
(b) whether the pepper of Vietnam has
been routed to India through Sri Lanka by
misusing free trade import facilities and if
so, whether Government initiated any steps
to check the misuse of trading provisions;
and
(c) whether Government propose to set
up any limitation for the import policy to
check the misuse of the concerned
provisions?
Export of cash crops
*302. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details on the export of cash
crops, particularly cashew nut and import
of cashew kernels in India for each of the
last three years;
(b) whether Government have taken
any steps to modernize the industry by
introducing new technology;
(c) if so, details thereof; and
(d) the steps proposed to increase
export of cash crops?
Construction of dwellings under IAY
in Punjab
*303. SHRI VARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of dwellings constructed
in Punjab under Indira Awaas Yojana during
2004-05 against the target fixed; and
(b) the dwelling units likely to be
constructed during 2005-06?
SEZs established in the country
*304. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:

94
(a) the State-wise details of SEZs
established so far;
(b) what are the advantages of
establishing the SEZs; and
(c) how many of these SEZs have been
established in backward regions of the
country?
Steps to improve balance of trade with
ASEAN
*305. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that steep import
tariffs slapped by Association of South East
Asian Nations (ASEAN) have been
disturbing India’s trade balance with them;
(b) if so, details thereof and reasons
therefor; and
(c) steps being taken to improve the
balance of trade with ASEAN?
Jehanabad Jail attack
†*306. SHRIMATI SUSHMA
SWARAJ:
SHRI AJAY SINGH
CHAUTALA:
 Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
contemplating on formulating any joint
policy with Nepal to combat maoists after
the incident committed by naxalites in
Jehanabad;
(b) if so, the steps taken so far in this
regard; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Black-listing of NGOs
*307. SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT   be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have black-
listed several Non-Governmental
Organizations due to their involvement in
corrupt practices;
(b) if so, the names of such banned
NGOs, till date;
(c) what are the details of Government
amount siphoned off by these NGOs; and
(d) whether Government propose to
tighten the guidelines for grant of financial
assistance to NGOs and if not, reasons
therefor?
Rape cases with minors in Delhi
*308. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that rape cases
with minor girls are on the increase in the
country during these days;
(b) if so, the State-wise details thereof
for the last three months;
(c) whether it is also a fact that more
than sufficient time is taken by the court to
punish the defaulters; and
(d) if so, the instructions to be issued
for taking decision at the earliest in such
cases and by when such instructions are
expected to be issued?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

95
States lagging behind in the PMGSY
*309. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT   be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 15 States are
lagging behind in the ‘Pradhan Mantri Gram
Sadak Yojana’;
(b) if so, which are the States and the
year from which they have not claimed their
share of funds from the Central
Government; and
(c) why such lapses were not detected
during this period through annual review
meetings held from time to time?
Provisions in the Armed Forces
Tribunal
*310. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the proposed Armed Forces
Tribunal will address the inherent blatant
deficiency in military law i.e. the absence
of remedy of appeal against the order of
the court martials;
(b) whether the existing court martial
system under military law is regulated by
mere power of military command rather
than law;
(c) whether the western nations have
upgraded their military justice system at
par with ci

Total number of questions —155

Extension of subsidy on capital loans
to coffee growers
2267. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has extended
five and three per cent interest subsidy to
small and medium coffee growers
respectively on working capital loans
through the Coffee-Boards;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government would also like
to extent the subsidy;
(d) if so, the time-frame set for this
purpose;
(e) whether Government had also
waived the old development loans and
interest amounting to Rs. 64.50 crore availed
by small coffee growers from the Coffee
Board;
(f) if so, the details thereof; and
(g) what is the total financial benefit
given to the coffee growers from the special
package?
Import of iron-scrap
2268. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
allows import of scrap iron for use in steel
plants;
(b) if so, what is the policy with regard
to import duty on import of scrap iron for
actual users in the country;
(c) what steps are proposed by
Government to ensure that leakages and
frauds are prevented in this matter; and
(d) reasons for allowing low import duty
on import of scrap iron meant for re-export,
etc?
Blacklisting of agencies issuing Pre-
Shipment Inspection Certificates
2269. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether after the last year's
explosions in and around Delhi caused by

520

live shells imported as scrap, DGFT black
listed a number of agencies authorised by it
to issue Pre-Shipment Inspection (PSI)
certificates;
(b) if so, the details of such companies;
(c) whether live shells are still being
imported as scrap; and
(d) if so, the stringent action being taken
or proposed to be taken in this regard by
Government?
Increase in import of agricultural
products
2270. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that import of
agricultural products has gone up during
the last two years;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) steps taken to bring down
agricultural imports?
Facilities provided to increase
export
†2271. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that economic
and other facilities are provided by
Government to the units set up in different
zones established to increase export in the
country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) estimated value of economic facilities
provided to these units during the last three
years?
Setting up of beef industry
†2272. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have sought opinion from Ministry of
Environment and Forests regarding setting
up of beef industry by the multinational
companies in the country;
(b) if so, facts in this regard; and
(c) the reasons behind Government's
decision to consider the proposal of setting
up of beef industry in the country?
Steps for industrial promotion
2273. SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN:
MAULANA OBAIDULLAH
KHAN AZMI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) what steps have been taken by
Government for industrial promotion in the
country; and
(b) what have been the results of these
steps during the last two years and the
current year so far?
Livelihood provided by retail markets
†2274. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 40 per cent
people are earning their livelihood in retail
markets as a self-employment in the
country;

521
(b) if not, estimate made by Govern-
ment in this regard;
(c) whether it is a fact that by
incorporating technology based system in
present retail marketing system, more
employment opportunities would be
generated with less capital investment; and
(d) if not, the facts thereof and reaction
of Government in this matter?
Turnover of retail market

SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE

(a) whether it is a fact that turnover rate
of retail market in the country is constantly
increasing since last few years;
(b) if so, the average annual growth rate
of the same during last five years;
(c) whether its growth rate is required
to be increased while keeping in view the
